description: Implementation of FramePartsCollectorListener class for HTTP/2 frame testing, handling various frame events and logging.

classes.name: FramePartsCollectorListener
classes.description: A test tool class for collecting and handling HTTP/2 frame parts during testing.

methods.name: OnFrameHeader
methods.description: Handles the reception of a frame header, logs and expects header validity.

methods.name: OnDataStart
methods.description: Handles the start of data frame, logs and initiates frame processing.

methods.name: OnDataPayload
methods.description: Handles data payload within a frame, logs payload length.

methods.name: OnDataEnd
methods.description: Handles end of data frame, logs event.

methods.name: OnHeadersStart
methods.description: Handles start of headers frame, logs and initiates frame processing.

methods.name: OnHeadersPriority
methods.description: Handles priority information in headers, logs priority.

methods.name: OnHpackFragment
methods.description: Handles HPACK fragment data, logs length.

methods.name: OnHeadersEnd
methods.description: Handles end of headers frame, logs event.

methods.name: OnPriorityFrame
methods.description: Handles priority frame, logs header and priority fields.

methods.name: OnContinuationStart
methods.description: Handles start of continuation frame, logs header.

methods.name: OnContinuationEnd
methods.description: Handles end of continuation frame, logs event.

methods.name: OnPadLength
methods.description: Handles padding length, logs length.

methods.name: OnPadding
methods.description: Handles padding data, logs skipped length.

methods.name: OnRstStream
methods.description: Handles RST_STREAM frame, logs header and error code.

methods.name: OnSettingsStart
methods.description: Handles start of SETTINGS frame, logs header, checks frame type and flags.

methods.name: OnSetting
methods.description: Handles individual setting fields, logs fields.

methods.name: OnSettingsEnd
methods.description: Handles end of SETTINGS frame, logs event.

methods.name: OnSettingsAck
methods.description: Handles SETTINGS acknowledgment, logs header.

methods.name: OnPushPromiseStart
methods.description: Handles start of PUSH_PROMISE frame, logs header and promise info.

methods.name: OnPushPromiseEnd
methods.description: Handles end of PUSH_PROMISE frame, logs event.

methods.name: OnPing
methods.description: Handles PING frame, logs header and ping fields.

methods.name: OnPingAck
methods.description: Handles PING acknowledgment, logs header and ping fields.

methods.name: OnGoAwayStart
methods.description: Handles start of GOAWAY frame, logs header and goaway fields.

methods.name: OnGoAwayOpaqueData
methods.description: Handles opaque data in GOAWAY frame, logs length.

methods.name: OnGoAwayEnd
methods.description: Handles end of GOAWAY frame, logs event.

methods.name: OnWindowUpdate
methods.description: Handles WINDOW_UPDATE frame, logs header and window size increment.

methods.name: OnAltSvcStart
methods.description: Handles start of ALTSVC frame, logs header and origin/value lengths.

methods.name: OnAltSvcOriginData
methods.description: Handles ALTSVC origin data, logs length.

methods.name: OnAltSvcValueData
methods.description: Handles ALTSVC value data, logs length.

methods.name: OnAltSvcEnd
methods.description: Handles end of ALTSVC frame, logs event.

methods.name: OnPriorityUpdateStart
methods.description: Handles start of PRIORITY_UPDATE frame, logs header and update fields.

methods.name: OnPriorityUpdatePayload
methods.description: Handles payload of PRIORITY_UPDATE, logs length.

methods.name: OnPriorityUpdateEnd
methods.description: Handles end of PRIORITY_UPDATE, logs event.

methods.name: OnUnknownStart
methods.description: Handles start of unknown frame, logs header.

methods.name: OnUnknownPayload
methods.description: Handles payload of unknown frame, logs length.

methods.name: OnUnknownEnd
methods.description: Handles end of unknown frame, logs event.

methods.name: OnPaddingTooLong
methods.description: Handles case where padding is too long, logs header and missing length.

methods.name: OnFrameSizeError
methods.description: Handles frame size error, logs header.
